flora: Water lily flower (primitive, multi-petaled, pale cream or pinkish-white)
Water lily seed pod (clumpy, berry-like structure containing small dark seeds)
Water lily sprout (young submerged shoot with a single small unrolling leaf and roots)
Water lily pad (close-up of the floating leaf showing the waxy surface and radiating veins)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile textures like the waxy, water-repellent leaf surface and soft, translucent petals; clear quadrant separation for educational identification.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: The primitive flower; Top-Right: The seed-bearing pod; Bottom-Left: A submerged young sprout; Bottom-Right: A high-detail close-up of a floating lily pad.
visual_logic.ground: A backdrop of fine, light grey volcanic silt and smooth ash-colored stones partially submerged in clear water.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to ensure delicate structures like the flower petals and veins are visible.
